one_liner: Pumble has a self-serve REST API (API Keys addon on all plans including Free, plus OAuth2-style Pumble apps) and a vendor-promoted MCP server, so a toolkit is buildable now.
auth_notes: Pumble apps use an OAuth2 flow (authorization code via /oauth2/grant, token via /oauth2/access with client-id/client-secret). Requests carry a user/bot access token plus an x-app-token header. A simpler API key from the API Keys addon is sent as a bearer token. Composio only lists API_KEY. The OAuth flow details come from the OpenAPI spec, which is truncated, so confidence is medium.
access_notes: The API Keys addon is available on all plans, and Persona's docs say the free plan is enough. The Free plan allows up to 3 addons. Installing addons needs an Owner or Admin. Creating a custom app is done under Workspace settings > Configure apps > Create app.
blocker_notes: A workspace Owner or Admin must install the API Keys addon. The API Keys addon rate limit is 1000 requests/min per user. The API addon has no Events API, so webhook support is unconfirmed. The exact MCP endpoint URL is not stated in the provided pages.

evidence.quote: It's mandatory to include the token (access token issued to user/bot) and x-app-token (app token issued to your app, prefixed with 'xpat-') headers in every request
This token must be passed inside the HTTP header of every request as a bearer token.
